text:
Priya: Launching a small Dedicated G740 micro-pool in SIN and SYD today. Targeting low-latency APAC inference customers. Docs + reservation details below. :sparkles:
deploy-bot: [deploy] created pool g740-sin (size=14) and g740-syd (size=10)  rollout=rl-2026-g740-01
Sam: Are these part of reserved catalog or burst-only?
Priya: Phase 1 = limited invite-only reserved slots + open burst holds. Reservation window = up to 5 days. Well evaluate telemetry for Q3 integration into reserved offering.
finance: Pricing: micro-pool surcharge +10% per GPU-hour vs standard Dedicated. Enterprise committed customers can request surcharge review via billing case.
infra-team: Operational note: tag holds with project and region (e.g., project=voice-assist region=sin). Untagged holds auto-cancel after 8h.
Sam: Eviction policy? Will jobs be preempted?
Priya: Soft-preempt applies: 30m eviction notice via webhook + auto-fallback routing to nearest compatible pool (L-class). Customers will see an outage message in the console if preempted.
deploy-bot: [alert] monitor rule pool.g740-*-utilization > 82% for 12m -> page #eng-oncall
Sam: Can we get a quick CLI snippet for reservations?
Priya: CLI snippet:
```
# list g740 pools
redwoodctl pools list --filter "g740" --region sin
# reserve 1 GPU for 24h
redwoodctl reservations create --pool g740-sin --count 1 --duration 24h --tags project=my-app,env=prod
```
finance: Reminder to sales: disclose surcharge and preempt policy in quotes. Use pricing code G740-MICRO.
infra-team: Dashboard link (will be added to docs in 1h). Nightly cleanup job removes stale micro-pool holds >8h.
Priya: Thanks team  escalating issues to #eng-oncall. :pray:
